title: 煙氣脫硝系統~Flue-gas denitrification systems
focus: 比較 SCR 與 SNCR 的反應、混合、逸出與監測邊界~Compare SCR and SNCR through reaction, mixing, reagent slip and monitoring boundaries
summary: 本課以「比較 SCR 與 SNCR 的反應、混合、逸出與監測邊界」為主軸，依序處理氮氧化物入口基準、混合與空間速度、催化床壓降與積灰、氧校正與稀釋、量測性能與校正。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Compare SCR and SNCR through reaction, mixing, reagent slip and monitoring boundaries, progressing through NOx inlet basis, Mixing and space velocity, Catalyst pressure drop and deposits, Oxygen correction and dilution, Measurement performance and calibration. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

units.title: 氮氧化物入口基準~NOx inlet basis
units.mechanism: 先確認 NOx 報告基準與乾標準氣量，將濃度轉成可比較的質量負荷。 氣體污染質量流率須用同一標準溫壓與乾濕基的氣量、濃度相乘。~Confirm the NOx reporting basis and dry standard flow before converting to comparable mass loading. Gas pollutant mass rate requires flow and concentration at the same reference conditions and moisture basis.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.
units.verify: 針對「氮氧化物入口基準」，查驗溫壓、含濕率及濃度報表欄位，再核對煙道流速與面積。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For NOx inlet basis, Check temperature, pressure, moisture and concentration-report bases, then verify duct velocity and area. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「氮氧化物入口基準」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the NOx inlet basis flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 任何單位標成 m³ 的氣量都可直接乘 Nm³ 基準濃度。~Any flow labelled m³ can directly multiply a concentration based on Nm³.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 12000 Nm³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.2 變成 0.24 kg/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 12000 Nm³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.2 to 0.24 kg/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 反應計量與藥劑需求~Reaction stoichiometry and reagent demand
units.mechanism: 用抽象摩爾模型辨認理論需求與實際轉換的差別，不把比例當成現場注入設定。 化學計量給理論反應需求，實際投加還受混合、反應溫度及副反應限制。~Use abstract molar accounting to separate theoretical demand from actual conversion; ratios are not injection settings. Stoichiometry gives theoretical demand; real dosing also depends on mixing, temperature and side reactions.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：目標反應物 n=100 mol/h；理論摩爾比 s=1；假設投加比 R=1.10。公式 n_reagent=n*s*R，計算得 110 mol/h。適用邊界：抽象單一反應模型，比例僅供教學，不能直接作現場加藥量。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Target reactant n=100 mol/h; stoichiometric ratio s=1; assumed feed ratio R=1.10. Formula n_reagent=n*s*R gives 110 mol/h. Applicability: An abstract single-reaction model; ratios are teaching inputs, not field reagent settings.
units.verify: 針對「反應計量與藥劑需求」，用進出口物種分析追蹤反應與未反應藥劑，分別報去除量和逸出量。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Reaction stoichiometry and reagent demand, Track reactants and unreacted reagent at inlet and outlet; report removal and slip separately. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 過量投加可能增加藥劑逸出或殘渣，而非繼續改善去除。 在「反應計量與藥劑需求」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Excess feed can increase reagent slip or residue instead of improving removal. Mark where this error can enter the Reaction stoichiometry and reagent demand flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 藥劑投加越多，淨環境效益必定越大。~More reagent always gives greater net environmental benefit.
units.practice: 只將 R 改成 1.25，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 110 變成 125 mol/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only R to 1.25, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 110 to 125 mol/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 混合與空間速度~Mixing and space velocity
units.mechanism: SCR 催化床需均勻配流；局部高速度可能使平均空間速度掩蓋穿透。 空間速度是每小時氣量與催化劑體積之比；它與接觸尺度相關但不能單獨預測轉換率。~An SCR catalyst bed needs uniform flow; local high velocity can cause breakthrough hidden by a mean space velocity. Gas hourly space velocity is flow divided by catalyst volume; it relates to contact scale but does not alone predict conversion.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：氣量 Q=6000 m³/h；催化劑體積 V=3 m³。公式 GHSV=Q/V，計算得 2000 h⁻¹。適用邊界：一致溫壓基準與均勻配流；未含催化活性、溫度窗和中毒。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Gas flow Q=6000 m³/h; catalyst volume V=3 m³. Formula GHSV=Q/V gives 2000 h⁻¹. Applicability: Consistent gas reference and uniform distribution; catalyst activity, temperature window and poisoning are omitted.
units.verify: 針對「混合與空間速度」，比較不同區位的流速、溫度與逸出物，檢查壓降和催化活性趨勢。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Mixing and space velocity, Compare local velocity, temperature and slip; inspect pressure-drop and activity trends. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 局部堵塞令可用體積下降，名目體積計算會掩蓋劣化。 在「混合與空間速度」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Blockage reduces available volume, which nominal-volume calculations can conceal. Mark where this error can enter the Mixing and space velocity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 相同空間速度就保證任何催化劑有相同轉換率。~Equal space velocity guarantees equal conversion for every catalyst.
units.practice: 只將可用 V 改成 2.5 m³，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2000 變成 2400 h⁻¹。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only available V to 2.5 m³, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2000 to 2400 h⁻¹. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 反應溫度與熱需求~Reaction temperature and heat demand
units.mechanism: SCR 與 SNCR 的反應窗口不同，教學只用顯熱評估熱需求，不提供操作窗口。 顯熱依質量流率、比熱與溫差線性變動；相變潛熱必須另外計入。~SCR and SNCR have different reaction windows; the lesson estimates heat demand without prescribing operating windows. Sensible heat changes with mass flow, heat capacity and temperature difference; latent heat requires a separate term.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：質量流率 m=2 kg/s；比熱 cp=1.5 kJ/(kg·K)；溫差 ΔT=40 K。公式 P=m*cp*dT，計算得 120 kW。適用邊界：固定比熱、無相變、定常流；不可代替完整設備熱平衡。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Mass flow m=2 kg/s; heat capacity cp=1.5 kJ/(kg·K); temperature difference ΔT=40 K. Formula P=m*cp*dT gives 120 kW. Applicability: Constant heat capacity, no phase change and steady flow; not a complete equipment heat balance.
units.verify: 針對「反應溫度與熱需求」，在同一時段讀取流量與上下游溫度，加入散熱項後檢查能量殘差。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Reaction temperature and heat demand, Record flow and upstream/downstream temperatures over one interval; include losses and check the energy residual. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 忽略水分蒸發會把熱量全部誤算為升溫。 在「反應溫度與熱需求」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Ignoring evaporation incorrectly assigns all heat to temperature rise. Mark where this error can enter the Reaction temperature and heat demand flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 水分蒸發的能量已完全包含在固定比熱乘溫差內。~Evaporation energy is fully included in constant heat capacity times temperature rise.
units.practice: 只將 ΔT 改成 50 K，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 120 變成 150 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only ΔT to 50 K, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 120 to 150 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 催化床壓降與積灰~Catalyst pressure drop and deposits
units.mechanism: 催化活性下降與流道堵塞是不同失效，需將差壓與污染物轉換一起比較。 差壓反映測點間總阻力，須配合同時的流量與氣體狀態判讀。~Activity loss and flow-channel blockage are different failures; compare pressure drop with conversion. Differential pressure reflects resistance between taps and needs concurrent flow and gas-condition data.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：量測前壓 p1=1800 Pa；後壓 p2=600 Pa。公式 dp=p1-p2，計算得 1200 Pa。適用邊界：相同基準壓力與測點；單一差壓不能區分所有堵塞或洩漏原因。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Upstream pressure p1=1800 Pa; downstream pressure p2=600 Pa. Formula dp=p1-p2 gives 1200 Pa. Applicability: Common pressure reference and specified taps; one differential cannot identify every blockage or leak.
units.verify: 針對「催化床壓降與積灰」，檢查導壓管、零點和測點位置，再把差壓與流量趨勢一起畫出。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Catalyst pressure drop and deposits, Inspect impulse lines, zero and tap locations, then plot pressure drop with flow. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 導壓管堵塞可能被誤判為設備阻塞。 在「催化床壓降與積灰」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A blocked impulse line can be mistaken for equipment blockage. Mark where this error can enter the Catalyst pressure drop and deposits flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 只要差壓上升，就能確定濾材一定破損。~A higher differential pressure proves the filter medium is damaged.
units.practice: 只將 p1 改成 2200 Pa，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1200 變成 1600 Pa。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only p1 to 2200 Pa, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 1200 to 1600 Pa. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: NOx 去除與氨逸出~NOx reduction and ammonia slip
units.mechanism: 提高去除率時仍須追蹤未反應藥劑，單看 NOx 下降會漏掉副作用。 同基準入口與出口的差可估濃度去除率；氣量變動時應改比質量流率。~Track unreacted reagent when increasing removal; NOx decline alone misses side effects. Matched-basis inlet and outlet values give concentration removal; use mass rates when gas flow changes.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：入口濃度 Cin=100 mg/m³；出口 Cout=12 mg/m³。公式 eta=(Cin-Cout)/Cin*100，計算得 88 %。適用邊界：同一乾濕基、溫壓及流量；不以去除率取代出口排放判定。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Inlet concentration Cin=100 mg/m³; outlet Cout=12 mg/m³. Formula eta=(Cin-Cout)/Cin*100 gives 88 %. Applicability: Matched moisture, temperature, pressure and flow; removal percentage does not replace an outlet-emission assessment.
units.verify: 針對「NOx 去除與氨逸出」，同步採入口與出口並校正相同基準，另核對出口量測不確定度。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For NOx reduction and ammonia slip, Sample inlet and outlet simultaneously on the same basis and assess outlet measurement uncertainty. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 不同基準直接相減或用低於檢出限數值當零，會誇大效率。 在「NOx 去除與氨逸出」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Subtracting different bases or treating nondetects as zero exaggerates efficiency. Mark where this error can enter the NOx reduction and ammonia slip flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 去除率很高就能證明出口濃度符合任何排放標準。~High removal efficiency proves compliance with every outlet-emission limit.
units.practice: 只將 Cout 改成 20 mg/m³，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 88 變成 80 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Cout to 20 mg/m³, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 88 to 80 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 氧校正與稀釋~Oxygen correction and dilution
units.mechanism: 比較不同負荷時先統一氧基準，並保留未校正值供排查漏氣。 氧校正比較固定參考氧濃度下的稀釋程度，不能與乾濕基校正混為一項。~Normalize oxygen consistently across loads and retain raw values for leakage diagnosis. Oxygen correction normalizes dilution to a reference oxygen concentration and is separate from moisture correction.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾基濃度 C=50 mg/Nm³；量測 O₂=10%；假想參考 O₂ref=11%。公式 Cref=C*(21-O2ref)/(21-O2)，計算得 45.4545 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference。適用邊界：以 21% 空氣氧近似且氧測值遠低於 21%；參考值僅為算例，不聲稱適用法規。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry concentration C=50 mg/Nm³; measured O₂=10%; hypothetical reference O₂ref=11%. Formula Cref=C*(21-O2ref)/(21-O2) gives 45.4545 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference. Applicability: Approximate air oxygen at 21%, with measured oxygen well below it; the reference is illustrative, not a legal claim.
units.verify: 針對「氧校正與稀釋」，保存原始濃度、含濕與 O₂，再重算每項校正，防止對已校正數據重複校正。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Oxygen correction and dilution, Retain raw concentration, moisture and O₂ and recompute corrections to avoid double normalization. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 接近空氣氧含量時分母很小，微小氧誤差會放大。 在「氧校正與稀釋」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Near ambient oxygen the denominator is small and minor oxygen errors amplify strongly. Mark where this error can enter the Oxygen correction and dilution flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 氧校正能消除任何煙道漏氣與取樣代表性的問題。~Oxygen correction eliminates every leakage and sampling-representativeness problem.
units.practice: 只將量測 O₂ 改成 12%，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 45.4545 變成 55.5556 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only measured O₂ to 12%, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 45.4545 to 55.5556 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 分析延遲與控制判讀~Analyzer lag and control interpretation
units.mechanism: 進料、藥劑和出口訊號不同步會造成假因果，先重播延遲再討論回饋。 輸送延遲會把監測訊號與製程事件錯開，分析前須對齊時間。~Asynchronous feed, reagent and outlet signals create false causality; replay delays before interpreting feedback. Transport delay shifts monitoring signals relative to process events; align time before interpretation.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：取樣管容積 V=2 L；流量 q=0.5 L/min。公式 t=V/q，計算得 4 min。適用邊界：理想置換延遲，未含混合、吸附與分析儀響應時間。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Sampling-line volume V=2 L; flow q=0.5 L/min. Formula t=V/q gives 4 min. Applicability: Ideal displacement delay without mixing, adsorption or analyzer response time.
units.verify: 針對「分析延遲與控制判讀」，以安全參考訊號或離線脈衝重播測全系統響應，不只使用分析儀規格。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Analyzer lag and control interpretation, Use a safe reference signal or offline pulse replay to measure whole-system response, not analyzer specifications alone. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 管線冷凝或吸附會造成較長且不對稱的拖尾。 在「分析延遲與控制判讀」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Condensation or adsorption in tubing causes longer asymmetric tails. Mark where this error can enter the Analyzer lag and control interpretation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 分析儀更新每秒一次就代表取樣點到畫面只延遲一秒。~One-second analyzer updates imply only one-second source-to-display delay.
units.practice: 只將 q 改成 0.8 L/min，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 4 變成 2.5 min。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only q to 0.8 L/min, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 4 to 2.5 min. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 量測性能與校正~Measurement performance and calibration
units.mechanism: 藥劑濃度與 NOx 儀器各有零點與跨度誤差，需用獨立標準查核。 零點誤差與斜率誤差對不同濃度的影響不同，單點校正不能分開識別兩者。~Reagent and NOx instruments have separate offset and span errors requiring independent standards. Offset and slope errors affect different concentrations differently; a single calibration point cannot identify both.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：參考濃度 C=50；儀器響應 y=1.08*C+2。公式 bias=y-C，計算得 6 concentration units。適用邊界：假想線性響應，濃度單位前後一致；不外推至非線性量程。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Reference concentration C=50; instrument response y=1.08*C+2. Formula bias=y-C gives 6 concentration units. Applicability: Hypothetical linear response with common concentration units; do not extrapolate into nonlinear ranges.
units.verify: 針對「量測性能與校正」，用空白及至少兩個非零參考點檢查殘差，保留獨立查核樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Measurement performance and calibration, Use blanks and at least two nonzero references to inspect residuals, retaining an independent check standard. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只修正零點會留下隨濃度增加的斜率偏差。 在「量測性能與校正」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Correcting offset alone leaves concentration-dependent slope error. Mark where this error can enter the Measurement performance and calibration flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 零點校正正確就保證所有量程的讀值都正確。~A correct zero guarantees correct readings across the whole range.
units.practice: 只將 C 改成 100，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 6 變成 10 concentration units。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only reference C to 100, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 6 to 10 concentration units. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 催化劑壽命與交接~Catalyst life and handoff
units.mechanism: 交接應包含轉換、逸出、壓降和停機記錄，不能只用日曆年齡推定剩餘能力。 可用率描述指定期間能工作的時間比例，並不等於合格產出率。~Handoff includes conversion, slip, pressure drop and outages; calendar age alone does not determine remaining capacity. Availability is the working-time fraction over a specified period, not the compliant-output fraction.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總計畫時數 T=1000 h；停機 t=60 h。公式 availability=(T-t)/T*100，計算得 94 %。適用邊界：明確定義計畫時間與停機分類；未納入性能降額或品質不合格。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Scheduled time T=1000 h; downtime t=60 h. Formula availability=(T-t)/T*100 gives 94 %. Applicability: Defined scheduled time and downtime categories; derating and rejected output are excluded.
units.verify: 針對「催化劑壽命與交接」，對照事件紀錄、備援切換和品質資料，分開統計不可用及不合格時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Catalyst life and handoff, Compare event logs, backup switching and quality data, separating unavailable and nonconforming periods. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 設備在線但數據失效或處理不合格時，不能當作完整有效服務。 在「催化劑壽命與交接」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~An online unit with invalid data or nonconforming treatment is not fully effective service. Mark where this error can enter the Catalyst life and handoff flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 可用率 100% 就能保證所有產出或量測都合格。~One hundred percent availability guarantees all output and measurements conform.
units.practice: 只將 t 改成 90 h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 94 變成 91 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only downtime to 90 h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 94 to 91 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
